name: goey-toast
title: Goey Toast
description: A toast system whose compact pill widens into an organic card holding a status icon, title, description, optional action and a thin progress bar. Success, error and promise versions share the same morph.
use: An app needs rich status notifications with descriptions, actions and promise updates.
avoid: You only want a single-line alert; these cards take more room and animate for longer.
a11y: Strong: live announcements, labelled actions and Escape to dismiss; animations respect reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: On a dark demo page sit four outline trigger buttons under a short heading. A toast appears as a dark rounded card with a small circular check, a bold status line, grey description text, a right-aligned time and a thin green bar along the bottom.
behaves: A new toast starts as a small pill, melts open into the taller card with a spring, and its progress bar drains until it collapses back. Hovering holds it open, and an action label can flip to a success state.
customise: Call gooeyToast.success, error, info, warning or promise with title, description and action, and style via classNames, colours, timing and preset. The toaster takes position, theme and queue limits.
weight: light: A few animated toast cards with springs and timers; idle when no toast is shown.
demo: Triggers Success, Error, Promise, Action; toasts say Deployment complete and 'Built in 42s · 18 routes · 0 warnings.'
issues: Toasts with descriptions stay open until dismissed, so several can pile up.
Sound is on by default, which can surprise users the first time a toast fires.
polishWhy: Organic morph and clean card layout; multi-line toasts can linger and pile up.
